# Samsung Electronics America Cuts 739 Jobs in Englewood Cliffs, WARN Notice Shows - Community News Samsung Electronics America is cutting 739 jobs at its Englewood Cliffs headquarters, according to a Worker Adjustment and Retraining Notification reviewed by Reuters\. The filing marks one of the largest single job reductions disclosed in New Jersey this year and comes as the company prepares to relocate its U\.S\. consumer electronics headquarters to Texas\. The cuts affect a unit that employs roughly 1,200 workers in New Jersey, according to a September press release from U\.S\. Rep\. Josh Gottheimer, whose district includes Englewood Cliffs\. The scale of the reduction underscores the impact a single corporate relocation can have on the state’s job market, even in a region outside Mercer County and the capital area\. ## What the WARN Notice Says Samsung Electronics America \(SEA\) oversees sales and marketing for Samsung Electronics’ displays, phones, televisions and home appliances across the United States\.
